text: Program Description This course is taught by international cultural exchange school Length of Schooling: 4 years Admission only available in Fall Semester, opening in September The exact opening date is available in Acceptance Letter. Application Deadline For the programs in Hongkou Campus by June 30 Completion of Program Diploma and Certificate of Bachelor\'s Degree will be issued to those who have completed the undergraduate program with qualified academic standing. Career most people in the baosteel group, Oriental international group and other large state-owned foreign trade enterprises, general electric, multinationals such as unilever, Siemens, maersk logistics, international big four accounting firms, HSBC, standard chartered bank, bank of China and foreign countries, and other joint ventures with Chinese companies overseas agencies. Notes 1) The financial support and custody may be student\'s parents or relatives in Shanghai. 2) Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU.
